svg.title: 21c Application: Mpumudde Furniture Works (your decision)
svg.text: 7 required for Furniture · all received and checked

g.text: Prequalify for Furniture until 31 Dec 2026. I visited the workshop on 8 Oct: 14 staff, capacity about 40 desks a week, three references confirmed. It would give the
Kamuli desks RFQ its third prequalified supplier.
Joseph Waiswa prepared this recommendation, so only
someone else can approve or reject it.

svg.text: Required when you return or reject.
